bio: Hello! I am Serhat Yildirim from Belgium. I studied medicine at Ghent University in Belgium and pursued another master's degree as a Fulbright and Fayat scholar in Global Health Delivery at Harvard Medical School. I have a great interest in healthcare and human rights, which led me to work as a research associate at the FXB Center for Health and Human Rights at Harvard University. Besides academia, I enjoy traveling - exploring new cultures and parts of the world - hanging out with friends, and discovering new things. I am looking forward to contributing to the joyful community at Harvard! Community Yards Elm Yard Area Residential Life Proctors Role Residential Proctors
